chunks: Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Yahya ibn Imran from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
Bravery is among the people of Khurasan, physical vigor among the people of Barbar, and generosity and envy among the Arabs; so choose carefully for your offspring.

key_terms.لِنُطَفِكُمْ: for your seed, offspring, or procreative lineage

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about choosing lineage for marriage and offspring?
ai.summary: This hadith attributes certain commonly observed qualities to different peoples and concludes with advice to be selective in matters of lineage and marriage. Its significance lies in directing attention to traits that may affect family formation and offspring.
